scope: Xbox-facing platform libraries reviewed during Frosty bring-up, including the input, audio and media providers reached through the host. Coverage describes translation of console interfaces. Package middleware and ordinary Win32 dependencies are inventoried separately.

levels.complete: All identified console exports and interfaces for the reviewed build have an implemented, behaviorally verified replacement.
levels.partial: A TuxBox provider or named reference bridge implements at least one verified Xbox-facing behavior. Other exports, interface methods or execution paths remain open.
levels.incomplete: The baseline has no verified replacement for this library's Xbox-specific behavior. Tests may exercise the original binary or the host implementation.

libraries.name: d3d12_xs.dll
libraries.provider: TuxBox Rust D3D12 provider. The retail run uses patched TomBox.
libraries.scope: TuxBox creates a device for profile 0x20002 and submits two guest command lists with verified output. The reference path accepts Frosty's 0x20004 profile and renders the menu and movies.
libraries.remaining: More device profiles, shader and resource operations, and correct real-time chase rendering.

libraries.name: dxcompiler_xs.dll
libraries.provider: TuxBox PE forwarder to desktop DXC.
libraries.scope: DxcCreateInstance supplies a working IDxcUtils factory. A 257-byte blob retained its contents and lifetime across interface releases on Valve and GE-Proton.
libraries.remaining: The reviewed console DLL also exports DxcCreateInstance2, CreateXdxrCompiler and CreateXdxrCompiler2.

libraries.name: xmem.dll
libraries.provider: TuxBox Rust allocator. The retail reference run uses TomBox.
libraries.scope: Six named and ordinal exports cover allocation/free, working-set statistics and virtual allocation. Guest tests check alignment, reservation, page access and lifetime.
libraries.remaining: Physical page allocation, mapping and release needed by Frosty, plus GPU-visible memory and additional attribute profiles.

libraries.name: xg_xs.dll
libraries.scope: Four RGBA8 and BC7 texture descriptions exercise linear and tiled layouts through XGCreateTextureComputer using TuxBox memory allocation.
libraries.remaining: Implement the texture computer and layout calculations in a replacement XG library.

libraries.name: xgameruntime.dll
libraries.provider: ScarlettX reference runtime with a task-queue fix.
libraries.scope: Frosty initializes the reference runtime and enters Unreal startup. A paired control verifies termination of a queue with a manual completion port.
libraries.remaining: Several runtime interface queries fail. User and service operations need broader coverage.

libraries.name: xcrdapi.dll
libraries.provider: TomBox storage bridge to desktop DirectStorage.
libraries.scope: DStorageGetFactory supplies the storage path Frosty uses to initialize its I/O dispatcher and mount its IoStore container.
libraries.remaining: Console-specific storage controls and additional request paths.

libraries.name: gameconfighelper.dll
libraries.provider: Supplied console configuration helper in the embedded-runtime trial.
libraries.scope: The loader found the supplied helper in the package-runtime experiment.
libraries.remaining: A replacement for configuration and package-identity queries with independent behavioral tests.

libraries.name: GameInput.dll
libraries.provider: TomBox GameInput bridge with TuxBox mouse and keyboard mapping.
libraries.scope: The retail menu accepts keyboard, mouse and Xbox D-pad input. A virtual Xbox controller verifies analog readings, simultaneous button presses, hotplug and keyboard fallback through Proton XInput.
libraries.remaining: Additional GameInput device kinds and interfaces, physical-controller checks and input-driven chase gameplay.

libraries.name: AcpHal.dll
libraries.scope: Frosty starts its mixer and submits an eight-channel buffer with the reference AcpHal provider.
libraries.remaining: The retail import trace still reports AcpHalReleaseShapeContexts unresolved.

libraries.name: XAudio2_9.dll
libraries.scope: Host XAudio2 accepts the title's first mixer buffer. A separate private stereo loopback matches the intro soundtrack.
libraries.remaining: Xbox-specific XAudio2 behavior has no independently verified replacement here.

libraries.name: GameChat2.dll
libraries.scope: Frosty declares 15 delay imports for game chat.
libraries.remaining: A working chat provider and a voice-session test.

libraries.name: mfplat.dll
libraries.provider: TuxBox sample bridge with TomBox and Proton Media Foundation.
libraries.scope: The bridge provides the D3D12 video-sample path. Guest readback and retail movie comparisons verify decoded output.
libraries.remaining: The remaining console Media Foundation platform and device-management interfaces.

libraries.name: mfhevcdec.dll
libraries.provider: TuxBox transform adapter around the supplied HEVC decoder.
libraries.scope: The adapter delivers synchronized D3D12 NV12 samples. Original intro and chase footage passed decoded-frame comparisons.
libraries.remaining: The codec implementation still comes from the supplied decoder. Other decoder modes need validation.

libraries.name: mfh264dec.dll
libraries.provider: TuxBox transform adapter around the supplied H.264 decoder.
libraries.scope: The registered H.264 transform returns D3D12 samples for both 1024 × 512 menu previews.
libraries.remaining: The supplied codec and additional output formats and transform modes.

libraries.name: mfreadwrite.dll
libraries.scope: The source-reader control opens a movie byte stream and obtains its video media type.
libraries.remaining: Console source-reader behavior relies on the host.

libraries.name: MSAudDecMFT.dll
libraries.provider: Supplied audio decoder registered in the test prefix.
libraries.scope: The original AAC decoder processes 96 access units. The six-channel PCM output was compared with FFmpeg.
libraries.remaining: A replacement for the packaged decoder.
